Oak Meadow Townhomes - 3 Bedroom, 2.5 Bath
410 Oak Meadow Dr, San Mateo, CA 94403
The 3 bedroom is $2,195 for the first 6 months, then $2,295. Months 1-2 half off the admin fee.
Pets: Dogs and cats welcome with a one-time $350 pet fee per pet. Weight limit 80 lbs, two pets max. No breed restrictions.
Resident pays electric about $70, internet. Water, sewer and trash billed at $95 a month flat.
Security deposit: $1,000 - $2,295 based on credit. Application fee $55 per adult. Admin fee $175.
Fenced patio. Walk to Baywood Elementary (0.4 mi). 2-car garage. Tours Saturdays.
